sourceQuestions.sourceText: Say the words. Cross out the one that does not rhyme. a three tree them sea b six sticks socks mix c nine fine night sign
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a them • b socks • c night

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Draw a line to join the words that rhyme. cat sun bee hen / tree ten hat one
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: cat – hat • sun – one • bee – tree • hen – ten

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write the missing letters of the alphabet. a b __ d e __ g h __ j k __ m n o __ q r s __ u v w x __ z
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: c, f, i, l, p, t, y

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Finish each word with sh, tr, st or gr. _ip (a boat) _ee (it has leaves) _ar (it shines at night) _een (the colour of grass)
Underline the noun and circle the verb in each sentence. a The kite flies. b The dog runs. c The bird sings.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Nouns: kite, dog, bird • Verbs: flies, runs, sings

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write the sentence again with capital letters and a full stop. yesterday ali and i flew a kite
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Yesterday Ali and I flew a kite.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Finish this lullaby with describing words. Choose from: silver twinkling bright sleepy. The ___ moon. The ___ stars. The ___ child.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Any of the words, one in each space — for example: The silver moon. The twinkling stars. The sleepy child.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Which word rhymes with cat? ( cup ) ( hat ) ( car )
Rhyming words have the same ( sound at the end ) ( first letter ) ( number of letters )
How many letters are in the English alphabet? ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 26 )
In "The kite zooms up in the sky", the verb is ( zooms ) ( kite ) ( sky )
Which number name is spelled correctly? ( eigt ) ( eight ) ( aight )
